tagline.en: Create stories. Adapt them. Ship them.
tagline.zh: 让故事从灵感出发，走向小说、短剧、游戏与视频。

canonical.en: ZenStory AI builds open-source agent skills and workbenches that take a story from research and drafting through to short drama, playable games, and narrated video — running inside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and DeepSeek Harness.
canonical.zh: ZenStory AI 打造开源的 AI 故事创作 Agent Skills 与工作台，覆盖从选题、拆解、写作到短剧、可玩游戏与解说视频的全链路，可在 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、DeepSeek Harness 等 Agent 环境中运行。

category.primary: agent skills for story creation and adaptation
category.note: 网文 / 短剧 are specialization attributes, not the category. An engine can only recommend you inside a category it has filed you under; this is the only category all six projects share.

en: ZenStory is the conversation-first workbench; Oh Story is the reusable fiction-writing workflow for coding agents.
Drama Skills, Novel to Game and Video Recap Skills carry a source story into short drama, interactive and video formats.
Oh Story DSH brings novel, short-drama, game and video workflows into local DeepSeek Harness workbenches.
zh: ZenStory 提供对话优先的工作台；Oh Story 为编程 Agent 提供可复用的网文写作流程。
Drama Skills、Novel to Game、Video Recap Skills 把故事源带入短剧、互动与视频形态。
Oh Story DSH 将小说、短剧、游戏与视频流程带入本地 DeepSeek Harness 工作台。
